Want to experience China’s winter wonderland for yourself? Explore these unique winter train journeys with Huayun Luxury Trains:
🚂 Snow Country Train: https://huayunluxurytrains.com/tour/snow-country-train/
🚂 Lindu Express: https://huayunluxurytrains.com/tour/lindu-express/

If you’ve ever wanted to experience the China you see in our videos, come travel with us:
littlechineseeverywhere.com/tours

In this video, I’m taking you to Altay in Xinjiang, one of China’s most spectacular winter wonderlands.
Most people don’t know that, in the far northwest of China, there’s a remote region where China meets Kazakhstan, Russia and Mongolia — one of the few places in the world where four countries come together.
This time, I’m not traveling alone. I’m joined by my cousin and my niece as we explore the snowy landscapes, frozen villages and winter life of Altay.
Come with us on a family journey to one of the most beautiful corners of China in winter.
